fixture_kind: synthetic CPU reference inputs; not recorded model responses
purpose: Train an LLM to use MCP database tools with reinforcement learning.
mechanism: ART rollouts call an MCP SQLite server and assign rewards to tool-assisted answers; training quality depends on the reward contract.
experiment: Construct a shortcut that earns reward without solving the query, then revise the grader and compare held-out task success.
production: Run rollouts against disposable read-only database snapshots; keep the training coordinator separate from inference and tool servers.
